MemoryWritten.description:
An agent saves a memory with the `remember` tool, or removes one with `forget`. Each message is
one candidate, known by its `id`: its own task's later runs get it at once, and other tasks'
runs only once a person accepts it. A later write of the same name is a new candidate.

description.description: When an agent should read the memory. Absent for a forget.

forget.description: True for a forget: the candidate removes the memory of its name.

name.description: The memory's name, in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

runner.description: The runner that wrote it, or null in a factory of one runner.

task.description: The key of the task whose run wrote it.

text.description: The fact. Absent for a forget.
